people.name: Dimnah
people.line: A Levitical city in the territory of Zebulun.

people.name: Eth-kazin
people.line: Border town of Zebulun near Neah

people.name: Gath-hepher
people.line: Town in Zebulun; hometown of prophet Jonah

people.name: Neah
people.line: A border town of Zebulun and Asher

translations.web: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.
translations.bsb: From there it crossed eastward to Gath-hepher and to Eth-kazin; it extended to Rimmon and curved around toward Neah.
translations.kjv: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittahhepher, to Ittahkazin, and goeth out to Remmonmethoar to Neah;
translations.asv: and from thence it passed along eastward to Gath-hepher, to Eth-kazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretcheth unto Neah;
